entity_raw.definition_raw: Curse SubdomainSource Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1Associated Domain(s): LuckAssociated Deities: Andirifkhu, Calistria, Chinostes (Evil Aspect), Chinostes (Good Aspect), Dachzerul, Desna, Graffiacane, Lao Shu Po, Magdh, Raetorgash, YabuReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the bit of luck power of the Luck domain. Malign Eye (Su): As a standard action, you can afflict one target within 30 feet with your malign eye, causing it to take a –2 penalty on all saving throws against your spells. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until the target hits you with an attack. You can use this ability for a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.Replacement Domain Spells: 1st—bane, 3rd—bestow curse, 6th—eyebite.
